text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Possible cross-tenant routing anomaly detected for tenant 'zenith' (tenant_id=z-291). High-severity alert: suspicious traffic from dedicated-pool dp-12 appearing in logs for other tenants. Links: <https://metrics/redwood/alerts/1923456789|alert> 
Maya Chen: I'm on call — taking lead. @Raj @Linh can you grab network traces and KV access logs? Priya please stand by for customer comms. 
Raj Patel: grabbing KV logs now. Initial grep shows reads of key prefix "zenith:*/user" from nodes in pool dp-12 and dp-07. Sample lines:
```
[2026-03-10T14:05:02Z] node-dp12-07 GET /kv zenith:users:1234 -> served from /var/lib/redis/dp07/dump.rdb
[2026-03-10T14:05:04Z] node-dp07-03 GET /kv acme:session:zz -> served from /var/lib/redis/dp12/cache.rdb
```
Linh Nguyen: running vpc routing-audit script against fabric. Command:
```
./tools/routing-audit --vpc vpc-84 --pool dp-12 --since 2026-03-10T13:30Z
```
Linh Nguyen: found an overlapping route advertisement: route 10.93.0.0/16 advertised into dp-12 and dp-07 via control-plane bug. Dump:
```
route_id=rt-790 src=dp-12 dst=dp-07 prefix=10.93.0.0/16 origin=control-plane; priority=100
```
Priya Gomez: emailed Zenith primary contact (emma@zenith.co). They reported intermittent cross-tenant response earlier at ~14:04 UTC: "we got another customer's data in responses". They're on a call waiting for status. 
Dave R.: suggests immediate mitigation: withdraw route advertisement for 10.93.0.0/16 from dp-07 and place dp-12 into isolation mode. I'm prepping the command. 
Ops-Bot: Deploy request created by Dave R. — job id deploy-7753 is queued: route/withdraw(rt-790) target=control-plane. 
Raj Patel: suggested firewall kill-rule to drop cross-pool traffic for quick mitigation:
```
# on fabric-controller
ip rule add from 10.93.0.0/16 table blackhole pref 1000
ip route add blackhole 10.93.0.0/16
```
Maya Chen: executing withdrawal now (pm) — will update once done. Executed withdraw at 14:12 UTC. 
Ops-Bot: route/withdraw(rt-790) completed by deploy-7753 — success. No rollback necessary. 
Raj Patel: confirm: after withdraw, KV reads for zenith keys from dp-07 dropped to zero over 30s window. Query:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM kv_access WHERE tenant='z-291' AND pool='dp-07' AND ts >= '2026-03-10T14:04Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-10T14:16Z';
-> 0
```
Linh Nguyen: fabric audit shows no further overlapping advertisements. Still running deeper sweep for stray cached objects. 
Maya Chen: customer notified: "we isolated the pool and withdrew a conflicting route. We are investigating potential data exposure and will follow up with findings and remediation plan." Emma asked for initial ETA for sweep completion. 
Priya Gomez: told Emma we'll have a forensic sweep within 4 hours, immediate mitigation in place, would escalate to incident review board if any PII found. 
Raj Patel: running cache-scan job across dp-07 and dp-12 for keys matching tenant prefixes. Command:
```
./scripts/kv-scan --pools dp-07,dp-12 --prefix 'zenith:' --output /tmp/zenith-scan.json
```
Raj Patel: early results — 8 potentially mislocated keys found on dp-07, all non-PII (config hashes, feature flags). Moving them to a quarantine bucket and scheduling re-sync to correct pool. 
Linh Nguyen: adding this incident to routing-playbook tracker and flagging control-plane release v1.8.3 for rollback/patch. 
Maya Chen: good work. Next steps: Raj/Linh to complete sweep and remediation, Priya to handle customer comms, I'll prep the initial severity-1 postmortem draft and schedule 0900 incident review. 
Dave R.: please add compliance@redwood to the follow-up if any PII surfaces. 
Maya Chen: acknowledged. Closing live mitigation loop — monitoring for 30m. Please ping in thread with any new findings. :white_check_mark:
